name: factor-mining-batch-test
description: Local-MCP batch test plugin for direct vt_ Agent API Key Factor Mining workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Run single-factor and serial batch Factor Mining through bundled MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Factor Mining Batch Test lets Codex write local plugin.py factors, validate metadata, upload to Factor Mining, run user-scoped backtests, retrieve factor cards, summarize results, and run isolated serial batches through bundled MCP tools. The plugin stores a direct vt_ Agent API Key locally after secure local browser entry.
defaultPrompt: Show me the Factor Mining Batch Test public task list.
Use Factor Mining Batch Test with my custom factor idea.
Use Factor Mining Batch Test to mine 5 distinct factors from the public task list.
Switch Factor Mining Batch Test to a different vt_ key.
Resume my Factor Mining Batch Test run and summarize results.
